title: Dynamical Timelike Entanglement Entropy in an Evaporating Schwarzschild--AdS Black Hole
summary: Timelike entanglement entropy (tEE) has recently emerged as a novel probe of temporal quantum correlations in gravitational systems. Existing studies are largely restricted to static backgrounds. In this work we extend the construction of tEE to an evaporating Schwarzschild--AdS black hole. The evaporation is modeled through an effective Stefan--Boltzmann description of Hawking radiation coupled to an external absorptive bath, yielding a time-dependent horizon radius ($r_h(t)$) and surface gravity $κ(t)$.
